On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Gottfried von der Goltz - Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret? The internationally acclaimed pianist and Bach expert Robert Levin provides an answer.

programme.title: Kenny Barron - Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Ukraine
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker, Carey Bell, Jimmy Dawkins And Joe Harper - John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: Hooker's guitar play synthesises the rusticity of delta blues with the electricity and pulse of the city.

programme.title: Roberto Prosseda - Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 5, KV 283
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn. Since 2012, Prosseda also gives lecture-concerts with the robot pianist TeoTronico, as educational or family concerts, to demonstrate differences between a literal production of music and human interpretation.

programme.title: Chick Corea - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Marion Williams - Marion Williams Sings Spirituals
programme.desc: You can’t help but be carried away by the powerful voice Marion Williams, who, with backing from Tommy Brown (piano), Joe Washington (organ), Billy Tuliver (drums), and singers Barbara White and Ann Bolden, sings gospel songs and spirituals as if she has lived them a thousand times over. The repertoire includes such familiar tunes as “Peace in the Valley,” “We Shall Overcome,” and “Michael, Row the Boat Ashore.”

programme.title: Ginandrea Noseda - Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda. The acclaimed conductor Noseda (*1964) is one of the most important conductors of his generation. Recently, he taught a conducting masterclass at his alma mater for promising students from all over the world. For three days, Noseda joined forces with a hand-picked group of students to work on a varied concert programme. This documentary shows you these young, talented musicians rehearse compositions by Mozart, Tchaikovsky, and Stravinsky under the enthusiastic guidance of Maestro Gianandrea Noseda himself.

programme.title: Roberta Valente, Alexandre Ribeiro, Gian Correa And Henrique Araujo - Panorama do Choro - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Panorama de Coro. This ensemble combines jazz and traditional Brazilian music. The resulting music has a festive, almost street-like atmosphere. Panorama de Coro consists of Roberta Valente (pandeiro and percussion), Alexandre Ribeiro (clarinet), Gian Correa (7-string guitar), Henrique Araujo (cavaquinho), João Poleto (flute and tenor saxophone) and Yves Finzetto (pandeiro and percussion).

programme.title: Bertus Borgers, Gio Sliwa, Maurice Christian George And Wouter Mollen - Paradox Live: Bertus Borgers And The Young Retro's
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox. From young, local talents to top national and international artists, PARADOX Tilburg is the most intimate jazz club in the Netherlands, with a devoted audience from all across Europe. In their TV show PARADOX LIVE you get a taste of the greatest concerts and interviews with artists from all around the world. This episode of PARADOX LIVE presents the Tilburg based Bertus Borgers and his Young Retro's!

programme.title: Casco Phil And Benjamin Haemhouts - Shostakovich - Chamber Symphony Op. 110a
programme.desc: The Casco Phil, The Chamber Music Orchestra of Belgium, conducted by Benjamin Haemhouts, performs Shostakovich’s Chamber Symphony, Op. 110a. The work is a transcription by Rudolf Barshai of Shostakovich’s String Quartet No. 8, which was composed in only three days (July 12 to 14 1960). The work draws from Shostakovich’s pieces, like the Symphonies No. 1 and 5, and a Jewish theme from Piano Trio No. 2. Furthermore, it contains melodies from the first Cello Concerto and the Lady MacBeth opera. Recorded at the Elisabeth Center in Antwerp, Belgium.

programme.title: NoSax NoClar - jazzahead! 2023
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2023, jazzahead! paid special attention to Germany’s jazz scene and invited thirty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. Among the artists presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2023 is the French reed player duo NoSax NoClar. The intense bickering of Bastien Weeger’s saxophones and Stella Julien’s clarinet embodies the intimate relationship of two reed instruments in their exploration of free jazz and free-form music.

programme.title: Seiji Ozawa - Beethoven - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In September 2016, we celebrated the birthday of one of Japan's best-known conductors: Seiji Ozawa. Renowned for his advocacy of modern composers, Ozawa founded the Saito Kinen Festival Matsumoto in 1992. As of 2015, it is better known as the Seiji Ozawa Festival. Seiji Ozawa appeared on stage himself with 63 Saito Kinen Orchestra members, passionately conducting Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 and No. 7. Beethoven's Second Symphony was mostly written during the composer's stay at Heiligenstadt, at a time when his deafness was becoming more pronounced. The work premiered in the Theater an der Wien in Vienna on April 5, 1803. The Seventh Symphony premiered with Beethoven himself conducting in Vienna in 1813 at a charity concert for wounded soldiers. The Allegretto was the most popular movement and had to be encored.

programme.title: Morcheeba - Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2018, English trip-hop group Morcheeba performed at Jazz à Vienne. Led by vocalist Skye Edwards, the group languorously perform several songs from their 2018 album ‘Blaze Away’. Tinged with soul and lounge music, this is a great concert to relax to.

programme.title: Arthur Wagenaar - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Close Call
programme.desc: In Close Call your smartphone is a musical instrument. And you are not just an audience member, but a musician in a crazy band with three drummers! Arthur Wagenaar is a Dutch composer and musician. He has a deep love for rock bands, theatre, opera and classical music, and his music is usually a mixture of all of this. He also loves to invent his own instruments, mechanical or electronic, such as the “rampaphone,” a string instrument nine meters in length, the “kleurwerper,” played by juggling, and of course the Close Call Live app. In this performance from Classical:NEXT! in Rotterdam, he is supported by Joep Hendrickx, Tjalling Schrik, Marijn Korff de Gidts, Boy van Ooijen, Dodó Kis, Sarah Jeffery, Lotte Pen, Matthias Konrad, and Axel Schappert.

programme.title: Naoya Nishimura And Andrea Bacchetti - Works for violin and piano by Corelli, Ravel a.o.
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform an intimate recital recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan. On the program are Arcangelo Corelli’s Violin Sonata in D minor, Op. 5 No. 12, “La Folia”; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op. 24, “Spring”; Manuel de Falla’s 7 Canciones populares españolas; Maurice Ravel’s Sonata for violin and piano; Camille Saint-Saëns’ Introduction and Rondo Capriccioso in A minor, Op. 28; Niccolò Paganini’s Cantabile in D major, Op. 17; and Antonio Bazzini’s Scherzo fantastique, Op. 25, “La Ronde des Lutins”. This performance was recorded on June 22, 2019.

programme.title: Liran Donin - Liran Donin - Music Meeting
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, Tel Aviv-born bass player, producer and composer Liran Donin appeared here. Donin has collaborated with high-profile, cutting-edge artists, bands and projects. With his distinctive powerhouse groove and virtuoso approach to both the electric and double bass, Liran pushes the bass well beyond its boundaries.

programme.title: Heloise Werner, Oliver Pashley, Anne Denholm And Marianne Schofield - The Hermes Experiment
programme.desc: The Hermes Experiment, consisting of Heloise Werner (soprano), Oliver Pashley (clarinet), Anne Denholm (harp) and Marianne Schofield (double bass) is a UK-based contemporary quartet made up of harp, clarinet, voice and double bass. Capitalising on their deliberately idiosyncratic combination of instruments, the ensemble regularly commissions new works, as well as creating their own innovative arrangements and venturing into live free improvisation. The ensemble has commissioned over 50 composers at various stages of their careers. During this showcase recorded at Classical:NEXT 2019 in Rotterdam, The Netherlands, The Hermes Experiment performs “I Am Happy Living Simply'”and “The End of the Ending” by Emily Hall, “Samsara” by Alex Mills, and “Double Fiesta” by Meredith Monk.

programme.title: Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra - Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, Op. 73
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim. A few decades later in 1877, Brahms completed his Second Symphony, which is often compared to Beethoven’s Sixth Symphony given its cheerful and pastoral character.

programme.title: Vincent Appelby - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: La Fraîcheur - La Fraîcheur
programme.desc: For over a decade now, first in Paris, then Montreal and now in Berlin, La Fraîcheur has been brewing her blend of deep house and techno beats, making a name for herself with her signature sound of emotionally charged and acid techno sets. The queer feminist-activist is a marathon DJ who can go on for countless hours, running the gamut from classics to new songs released just hours earlier. Her craft expanded by producing music ranging from ravy epic techno to dark pumping electro, spacious open-air deep house to melancholic electronica. She wrote her critically acclaimed debut album during an artist residency with the Berlin-Detroit Connection. Since then, she has toured all over Europe, North and South America, and Japan, including at Burning Man, Fusion, and Garbicz Festival and famed clubs such as Tresor, About Blank, KitKat Club, Prince Charles, Kater Holzig. Enjoy her 2019 show at Trabendo Paris!

programme.title: Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir And Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger - Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: Der Schweizer Dirigent Ludwig Wicki leitet das Dänische Nationale Sinfonieorchester und den DR Junior Chor in einem glanzvollen Konzertprogramm mit Filmmusik. Das Programm umfasst eine Auswahl an Musik aus den besten und Oscar-ausgezeichneten Hollywood-Filmen wie Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart und Moulin Rouge, geschrieben von bedeutenden Komponisten wie John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner und Klaus Badelt. Zu den Höhepunkten gehören „He’s a Pirate/Davy Jones“ aus Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man’s Chest, „Now We Are Free“ aus Gladiator, „My Heart Will Go On“ aus Titanic und „Shallow“ aus A Star Is Born. Die hervorragenden Solisten dieses Konzerts sind die jungen, talentierten Sänger Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger und Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. Dieses Konzert wurde im Mai 2022 im DR Koncerthuset in Kopenhagen, Dänemark, aufgezeichnet.

programme.title: Wolfert Brederode, Gulli Gudmundsson And Jasper van Hulten - Paradox Live: Wolfert Brederode
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox. From young, local talents to top national and international artists, PARADOX Tilburg is the most intimate jazz club in the Netherlands, with a devoted audience from all across Europe. In their TV show PARADOX LIVE you get a taste of the greatest concerts and interviews with artists from all around the world. This episode of PARADOX LIVE presents the amazing Dutch pianist Wolfert Brederode.

programme.title: Sun Ra - Sun Ra Arkestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1985, pianist and space-faring jazz icon Sun Ra and his Arkestra crash-landed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Featuring saxophonists Marshall Allen, John Gilmore and Danny Ray Thompson, clarinetist Eloe Omoe, flautist James Jackson, trombonist Tyrone Hill and a cavalcade of other costumed talents, Sun Ra puts on a truly out-of-this-world concert.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: Karin Fernandes - Karin Fernandes - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist Karin Fernandes. She is dedicated to the performance of 20th and 21st century piano repertoire and has premiered numerous new compositions. As a soloist, Karin Fernandes has performed with prestigious Brazilian orchestras.

programme.title: Orlando Julius - BIRDtv: Orlando Julius
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.tv have been collaborating for a series of music programmes: ‘BIRD.tv’, allowing you to experience the best BIRD concerts and interviews as from a first row seat! In this episode, our guest is an old-timer from African music: the saxophonist and composer Orlando Julius (*1943). Doubtlessly, he is royalty among Nigerian musicians. In his music, Julius combines highlife, jazz, soul, and RAndB in ground-breaking ways.

programme.title: Ribattuta Ensemble, Dick Duijst, Rosina Fabius And Oscar Verhaar - Handel - Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: The Messiah (HWV 56) by Georg Frederich Handel, also known as “A New Sacred Oratorio”, tells the life and suffering of Christ: a story of passion, fire, and sacrifice. This is one of Handel's best-known works, which took only three weeks to compose this oratorio and its famous Hallelujah. The work has immense popularity since its premiere in Dublin in 1742, and is often presented at Easter. This performance of the Dutch ensemble Ribattuta Musica under the direction of conductor Dick Duijst was filmed in the grand church of the city of Ermelo, the Netherlands, in 2016. The soloists are Elvire Beekhuizen (soprano), Rosina Fabius (viola), Oscar Verhaar (counter-tenor) Satriya Krisna (tenor), and Hans Voschezang (bass). Ribattuta Musica is a professional ensemble that delivers authentic performances based on current musical practices at the time of the composers.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba, J.K. Naimro, Stanley Todd And Al Sanders - Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist. Her career flourished in the US, where she released several albums. Makeba was among the first African musicians to receive worldwide recognition. She brought African music to a Western audience, and popularized the world music and Afropop genres. Her performances at Estival Lugano is beyond incredible. Her voice, the power and the soul summarizes her musicality in 40 minutes, together with her band and extremely talented backing-vocals.

programme.title: Yllana, Florian Laconi, Margaux Toqué And Michaël Koné - The Opera Locos
programme.desc: In The Opera Locos (“The Opera of Crazies”), a comic opera show from the Spanish theater company Yllana and theatre producer Rami Eldar, five eccentric opera singers perform some of the greatest opera arias. Classical arias from George Bizet’s Carmen, W. A. Mozart’s The Magic Flute, and Giuseppe Verdi’s Rigoletto are combined with classics from the pop and rock repertoire. During the performance, the five characters reveal their hidden passions, personalities, and desires, leading to unpredictable, hilarious situations that audiences of all ages will appreciate. The soloists are Florian Laconi (tenor), Margaux Toqué (mezzo soprano), Michaël Koné (countertenor), Laurent Arcaro (baritone), and Diane Fourès (soprano). This performance was recorded at Théâtre Libre in Paris, France.

programme.title: Sander de Bie - Lorrèn at the North Sea Jazz Club: Shades of Blue
programme.desc: With her relaxed, bright voice, vocalist Lorrèn has made her name on the Dutch jazz scene. Lorrèn grew up in a family of music fans: from a very early age, she developed a fondness for the music of her great jazz heroine, Ella Fitzgerald. Also Selah Sue, Adele and Amy Winehouse influenced this wonderful soul, jazz, and pop singer. Lorrèn knows how to transport her audience to infinity with her contemporary music stamp. In this ‘Shades of Blue’ concert, which was recorded at Amsterdam’s North Sea Jazz Club, the vocalist knows how to entertain the audience. The combination of Lorrèns wonderful voice, her solid band, and fantastic new songs guarantee a wonderful evening!

programme.title: Misha Fomin - Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw (2020)
programme.desc: Misha Fomin performed romantic piano works at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in November 2020. His recital opened with Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Sonatas No. 10 and 15 'Pastoral', followed by works of Frédéric Chopin, Johannes Brahms, and Franz Liszt.

programme.title: Benjamin Herman, Joost Kroon, Frank van Dok And Willem Friede - New Cool Collective - Melkweg, Amsterdam
programme.desc: New Cool Collective is one of the foremost Dutch jazz ensembles. Pioneering new blends of music styles since 1993, NCC has performed in various formations, from small combos to larger ensembles and even big bands! The ensemble’s high energy is cut out for the dance floors, as dance, Latin, salsa, afrobeat and boogaloo all meet in a jazzy mix. NCC includes saxophonist Benjamin Herman, guitarist Rory Ronde, drummer Joost Kroon, percussionists Frank van Dok and Jos de Haas, pianist Willem Friede, bassist Leslie Lopez, and trumpeter David Rockefeller.

programme.title: Ricardo Herz, Michi Ruzitschka And Pedro Ito - Ricardo Herz Trio - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Ricardo Herz Trio consists of Ricardo Herz on violin, Michi Ruzitschka on nylon string guitar, and Pedro Ito on percussion. Band leader Ricardo Herz is a classically-trained musician, who also studied jazz at the prestigious Berklee College of Music.

programme.title: Ying Li - PIAM - Semi-final II: Mozart and Bartók
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Ying Li (China, 1997) performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sonata No. 13 in B-flat major, K. 333, and Béla Bartók’s Sonata, BB 88, Sz.80. This performance was recorded at Nuovo Teatro Ariberto in Milan, in June 2021.

programme.title: Sonya Lifschitz And Robert Davidson - Lifschitz And Davidson
programme.desc: Sonya Lifschitz is a pianist working across many contexts, with repertoire spanning from 15th century Faenza Codex to works written for her today. She is known for her fiercely imaginative, daring collaborations across film, animation, spoken word, visual and performance art. Robert Davidson has been making music from language since childhood. He has created music from the voices of Australia's prime ministers, from 100 years of radio broadcasts and from stories of asylum seekers and indigenous members of Australia's Stolen Generations. This performance is recorded during Classical:NEXT 2019 in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons - Dvořák - Symphony No. 8, Op. 88
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák’s Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber’s Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979)

programme.title: Anna Calvi - At Salle Pleyel 2019
programme.desc: Strongly influenced by Hispanic culture, the English singer-songwriter Anna Calvi makes her voice and guitar vibrate with the ardor of flamenco. She gives a powerful, biting, and incredibly moving performance at the Salle Pleyel in Paris.

programme.title: Clark Terry - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 9, a profoundly emotional and technically complex work from 1909-1910, is characterized by its sprawling, late-Romantic style, exploring themes of human experience, love, and existential questions against the backdrop of Mahler's own impending death. Audiences are drawn to the symphony's deeply personal expression of vulnerability and its transcendent final movement, which serves as a poignant farewell and a profound exploration of the human condition.

programme.title: Michel Legrand - Michel Legrand Orchestra at Spa, 1982
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra. During this 1982 performance in the Belgian town of Spa, Legrand leads his orchestra through a number of original songs, including “The Summer Knows,” “What Are You Doing the Rest of Your Life?” and “Les Moulins de mon Cœur.” Singing either in English or French, Legrand delivers a spirited performance with plenty of romantic flair that is sure to capture your heart.

programme.title: Kathleen Tagg And Andre Petersen - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Tagg And Petersen
programme.desc: The Kathleen Tagg / Andre Petersen piano duo brings together two of South Africa's most celebrated pianists: one eclectic-experimental classical and one jazz artist, in a unique and highly personal collaboration. Drawing inspiration from the rich sonic tapestries of classical music, nuances of South African jazz and traditional musics from sub-Saharan Africa, this duo explodes the concept of what two pianos can sound like: a bass guitar, goema drum, marimba and uhadi–plus mixing fully composed scores with improvisation in a bold, vital and highly entertaining mix with performances of original compositions and works by iconic South African jazz composers such as Abdullah Ibrahim, Bheki Mseleku and Moses Molelekwa. Tagg and Petersen explore diverse realms of possibilities within the sound world of the piano, their musical offerings paying tribute to the poignant legacy of people who have inspired their world-view and music making. In this performance from the 2019 edition of Classical:NEXT!, the talented pianists perform Bheki Mseleku, Angola, African Dawn / Cape Doctor, Second Time Around, Rapela, Time Watchers and Berimbau.

programme.title: Neeme Järvi - Saint-Saëns - Intro and Rondo Capriccioso, Op. 28
programme.desc: The Waldbühne in Berlin, one of the most appealing outdoor amphitheatres on the European continent, is the home of the Berliner Philharmoniker’s summer concerts. With over 22.000 in attendance, they are some of the most popular classical music concerts in the world. This year the outstanding orchestra under the baton of Neeme Järvi take us on a trip to Arabian “Thousand and One Nights”, with soloist Janine Jansen, a rising star who quickly gained the reputation of one of the foremost young violinists on the international concert stages. On the program are Rimsky-Korsakov's Scheherazade, Symphonic Suite, op. 35, Grieg's 'Peer Gynt' Suite No.1, op. 46, excerpts from Nielsen's Aladdin Suite for Orchestra op. 34, Saint-Saëns's Introduction und Rondo capriccioso and Meditation” from 'Thais' by Massenet.

programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: Daniel Harding - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Oran Etkin - jazzahead! 2024 interview - Oran - Open Arms
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Anna Calvi - At Salle Pleyel 2019
programme.desc: Strongly influenced by Hispanic culture, the English singer-songwriter Anna Calvi makes her voice and guitar vibrate with the ardor of flamenco. She gives a powerful, biting, and incredibly moving performance at the Salle Pleyel in Paris.

programme.title: Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir And Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger - Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: Der Schweizer Dirigent Ludwig Wicki leitet das Dänische Nationale Sinfonieorchester und den DR Junior Chor in einem glanzvollen Konzertprogramm mit Filmmusik. Das Programm umfasst eine Auswahl an Musik aus den besten und Oscar-ausgezeichneten Hollywood-Filmen wie Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart und Moulin Rouge, geschrieben von bedeutenden Komponisten wie John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner und Klaus Badelt. Zu den Höhepunkten gehören „He’s a Pirate/Davy Jones“ aus Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man’s Chest, „Now We Are Free“ aus Gladiator, „My Heart Will Go On“ aus Titanic und „Shallow“ aus A Star Is Born. Die hervorragenden Solisten dieses Konzerts sind die jungen, talentierten Sänger Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger und Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. Dieses Konzert wurde im Mai 2022 im DR Koncerthuset in Kopenhagen, Dänemark, aufgezeichnet.

programme.title: Giana Viscardi And Gustavo Marques - Brazilian NYE
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is the duo of Giana Viscardi and Gustavo Marques. After starting their career together, Giana Viscardi and Gustavo Marques released music in many places around the world. After returning to Brazil, they worked together on Giana's album ORUM, performing in Africa, Europe, and Brazil. In this episode, Giana Viscardi and Gustavo Marques perform conductor and arranger Letieres Leite's arrangements of their work. Enjoy their fantastic Afro-Brazilian jazz, which combines the best of various continents.

programme.title: Muse - Live at Festival Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring (Nürburgring), Rock Im Park (Nuremberg) is a music festival that takes place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in western Germany. Featuring Muse.

programme.title: Emmanuel Hovhannisyan, Avag Margaryan, Kevork Mourad And Tineke Postma - The Morgenland Festival: I Will Not Be Sad
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival, held in Osnabrueck, has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. Jivan Gasparyan Jr has always been inspired by the folk melodies of his native Armenia. His grandfather, also a musician, taught him the art of duduk, an instrument of Armenian origin.

programme.title: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra And Emma Smith - The Babylon Hotel
programme.desc: Nur eine Nacht! Willkommen in der spektakulären und dekadenten Welt des Babylon Hotel, wo Musik aus jeder Ecke wie sprudelnder Champagner fließt. In diesem Konzert trifft die Oberschicht auf die Unterwelt in einer Mischung aus Euphorie und Extravaganz, Nostalgie und Vergnügen, mit einer sorglosen Sündhaftigkeit, wie man sie nur im überschwänglichen Nachtleben der 1920er Jahre weltweit findet. Das Konzert präsentiert ikonische Musik aus Filmen und Serien wie The Great Gatsby, Burlesque und Babylon Berlin. Die Musik wird vom Danish National Symphony Orchestra und dem DR Big Band unter der Leitung von Miho Hazama aufgeführt. Das Konzert präsentiert auch das Moka Efti Orchestra sowie die Sänger Madame le Pustra, Emma Smith, Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch und Nikko Weidemann, begleitet von den Tänzern der Sweet Burlesque. Diese Aufführung wurde im Mai 2023 im DR Koncerthuset in Kopenhagen, Dänemark, aufgezeichnet.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Be Good (Lion's Song)
programme.desc: Unlike many of his fellow jazz cats, vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble. After sustaining a shoulder injury, this former American football player turned to jazz singing. He was discovered in a Californian jazz club by pianist, saxophonist and composer Kamau Kenyatta. Porter lent his vocal skills to gospel choirs across the country and a string of successful musicals before turning his talent to his own compositions. His rise since then has been meteoric. Porter’s magnificent, burnished baritone can sink into a lyric with luxurious ease, the melody gently sculpted into new shapes at every turn, with the rhythm tugging subtly back and forth across the bar line. This live performance at the Olympia showcases this man's worth, and is a truly amazing experience!

programme.title: Bertus Borgers And The Young Retro's - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Beth Ditto - At L'Aéronef Lille 2017
programme.desc: Gossip fans, rejoice: Beth Ditto makes a big comeback! With her new album, the fiery singer launches into a solo career. With the boundless energy, undeniable humor, and legendary generosity that characterize her, the American phenomenon presents brand-new songs. Beth Ditto is more than a singer: she is an inescapable figure of the world’s pop culture. As the lead singer of indie rock band Gossip (1999-2016), this young woman pulled off spectacular stage performances and gave hilarious interviews, greatly contributing to her sympathy capital. Her 2017 album mixes blues, pop, country, and rock, paying tribute to her native Arkansas in twelve eclectic and unifying pieces. Experience Beth Ditto as never before in this appearance at L'Aéronef Lille 2017!

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma And Eleonora Buratto - Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini’ in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me’. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me’. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae’ especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Sandro Schneebeli - DJAZZ Portrait: Sandro Schneebeli
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts. They revive the memory of the festival, the music and the experience.

programme.title: Christine Kamau - jazzahead! 2024 - Christine Kamau (KE)
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead! paid special attention to the jazz scene of the Netherlands and invited over forty jazz acts to perform over the course of three days. Among the ensembles presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2024 is trumpeter Christine Kamau’s quartet. Kamau, hailing from Nakuru, Kenya, skillfully blends African rhythms with jazz fusion. She cites Hugh Masekela as her favorite trumpeter, with Roy Hargrove and Miles Davis also serving as significant influences. Using music as a means to promote unity, Kamau has appeared at jazz festivals across Africa, and has been involved in projects with organizations like Pro Helvetia, the British Council, and UNESCO. At jazzahead!, Christine Kamau (trumpet, vocals, synthesizer, keys) appears with Victor Kimetto (keys), Isaac Kimetto (bass), and Richard Wandati (drums).

programme.title: Ed Harcourt, Carl Barât And Peter Doherty - Sgt. Pepper Tribute at Philharmonie de Paris 2017
programme.desc: Celebrated as one of the most influential albums of all times, The Beatles' 1967 Sgt. Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band marked its time and inspired generations of artists. While the album was purely a recording studio product, Beatles’ fans continue to be frustrated by not hearing it live. British musician and composer Ed Harcourt, author of six highly acclaimed albums and collaborator of vocalists Marianne Faithfull, Patti Smith, and trumpeter Erik Truffaz, gathered a supergroup for this occasion with top artists from the British independent rock scene. Join Ed Harcourt and members of The Libertines, Supergrass, The Coral, the Beta Band, and Primal Scream for this special tribute.

programme.title: Marc-André Hamelin - Legato - World of the Piano
programme.desc: We live in a renaissance of the piano”, as the New York Times has recently put it. With virtuosic flair and an eagerness to expand the repertoire, a new generation of pianists has revitalized the instrument’s appeal. In addition to the usual classics, they perform formerly scorned works or discover neglected composers. Legato is a series dedicated to presenting some of this new movement's most fascinating pianists – their individual approaches, their fresh ideas and their music. Each episode portrays an artist and shows an aspect of the world of the piano. The sum of these portraits provides viewers with an overall picture of the art of the pianist. Montréal native Marc-André Hamelin is internationally renowned for his musical virtuosity and refined pianism. The Times described one of his performances as “ultimate perfection”. He plays works by Haydn (Piano sonata in E major), Chopin (Piano sonata No. 3), Debussy (‘Préludes’, book two), Hamelin (Etude No. 7), as well as two short pieces by Gershwin (‘Do, Do, Do’ and ‘Liza’).

programme.title: Kim Zombik And Nicolas Caloia - jazzahead! 2022
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead! paid special attention to Canada’s jazz scene and invited forty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. Among the performing artists are vocalist Kim Zombik and double bassist Nicolas Caloia. The music of this Montreal-based duo, which goes by the name of Silvervest, is characterized by tenderness, humor and tunefulness. The band’s name pays homage to an item of clothing favored by the indefatigable and endlessly creative legendary drummer Elvin Jones.

programme.title: Jeditah van der Meulen, Brendan Jan Walsh And Jordy Pama - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Jeditah
programme.desc: Jeditah is an experimental songwriter, producer and singer from Amsterdam. She works with Brendan Jan Walsh on cello and Jordy Pama on synths and electronics. From an early age on, Jeditah has been immersed in the world of music, travelling with her parents as a music collective. She finds inspiration in the works of acclaimed artists like Björk, James Blake, Laurie Anderson and PJ Harvey. When she began experimenting with making her own music, she first only utilized her own voice, lowering and altering it, and eventually adding electronic beats and synths. With Electric AlleyCat, Jeditah has established her position as a singer and songwriter. In between performing and recording with the band, she creates layered soundscapes from old recordings and homemade samples. It's here where she develops her very own sound: playful, melancholic and adventurous – music that speaks to the imagination of the listener. In this concert from 2019's Classical:NEXT!, she performs Horseman You And Me, Lay Down, The Night, Differently and Private Space.

programme.title: Arsenik - Arsenik - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The mythical duo Arsenik is a rap group from France, made up of two brothers, Lino and Calbo. The team performs at Olympia Paris to celebrate their 20 years since their first album, Quelques gouttes suffisent… It’s a unique concert: Arsenik plays the entire album with numerous special guests for the first time. The album has sold over 300,000 copies in France. Today it’s being considered a classic, and it continues to be cited in the top five of the best French rap albums of all generations. Enjoy Arsenik’s live show in Olympia Paris!

programme.title: Raul Midón - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: Fuá Do Guegué - Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. Curated by its percussionist and leader, Guegué Medeiros, the collective Fuá Do Guegué aims to bring together professionals and artists who identify with and value the rhythms, characteristics, and art of Brazil’s Northeast. With a healthy disregard for preconceived notions and restraints, the collective combines music, film, and dance in their eclectic and highly energetic sets. Fuá Do Guegué consists of Guegué Medeiros (percussion); Salomão Soares (piano); Lau Trajano (bass); Danilo Moraes, Beibe, and Janayna Pereira (percussion and vocals); and Olivio Filho (accordion).

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Memory of a Concert
programme.desc: In 2006, Gidon Kremer and Martha Argerich set out on tour performing solos and duets by Bartók und Schumann. The last of the concert series at the Berliner Philharmonie has been recorded for this film, featuring a rare solo performance by Martha Argerich. A concert film with personal and moving commentary by Gidon Kremer. Program: Schumann's Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 10, Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 121; Kinderszenen, Op. 15; Bartók: Violin Sonata No. 1 Sz 75; Violin sonata No. 2 Sz 76.

programme.title: Miles Davis - Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Daniel Harding, Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, Coro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino And Christiane Karg - Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna. At the time, Mozart was busy working on his operas La clemenza di Tito and The Magic Flute. By the time he started on the Requiem, in the fall of that same year, his health was seriously declining. Mozart passed away in December 1791, leaving the Requiem uncompleted. His pupil Franz Xaver Süssmayr completed Mozart’s swan song in the form known today, based on Mozart’s sketches and possibly verbal instructions. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Olivier Bogé, Géraldine Laurent, Pierrick Pédron And Thomas de Pourquery - Charlie Parker - Bird with Strings Revisited
programme.desc: In the late 1940s, jazz saxophonist Charlie 'Bird' Parker expressed his wish to record with a classical string section rather than his usual jazz quintet. This desire was fulfilled in 1949 and 1950 when he recorded two albums with oboe, harp, string section and a jazz rhythm section, released as 'Charlie Parker with Strings'. Fast forward 70 years, when saxophonists Olivier Bogé, Géraldine Laurent, Pierrick Pédron, Thomas de Pourquery, and Jaleel Shaw follow in the jazz legend's footsteps, revisiting the repertoire of those original albums in this 2019 concert at The Philharmonie de Paris. Bastien Stil conducts Christophe Dal Sasso's new orchestral arrangements in this genre-blending concert, which opens with Dal Sasso’s very own Overture pour cinq saxophones et orchestra.

programme.title: Misha Mengelberg - Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician.

programme.title: Micah McLaurin - PIAM - Semi-final I: Chopin and Scriabin
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Micah McLaurin (USA, 1994) performs Frédéric Chopin’s Nocturne Op. 27 No. 2, and Barcarolle, Op. 60; and a selection of Alexander Scriabin’s Etudes: Op. 42 No. 5, and Op. 8 Nos. 11 and 12. This performance was recorded at Teatro EDI Barrio’s in Milan, in January 2020.

programme.desc: Sov gott, lilla groda. I en fantastisk trädkoja fylld av böcker samlas Lisette, Antoine, Fanny och Tiago för att leka och läsa sagor.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: Häng med sex charmiga superkompisar när de hamnar i roliga vardagssituationer och knasigheter!

programme.title: Hej Jycke
programme.desc: Vi älskar alla djuren-märket. Hej små vänner! Undrar vad Jycke tänkt hitta på med er idag?.

programme.title: Greta Gris
programme.desc: Greta är en glatt grymtande liten gris som bor med mamma Gris, pappa Gris och lillebror Georg. Greta tycker om att spela spel, leka och klä ut sig men det absolut bästa hon vet är att hoppa i lerpölar.

programme.title: Daniel Tigers kvarter
programme.desc: Daniel Tiger leker med vännerna i sitt kvarter och lär sig saker som är viktiga för att förstå andra människor och världen han växer upp i.

programme.title: Hårt väder
programme.desc: David Batra beger sig till Oklahoma City - mitt under tornadosäsongen. Ute på prärien upptäcker han att fascination och skräck ligger alltför nära varandra. I denna serie ger David Batra sig ut på sitt livs resa. Hans uppdrag: att lära sig hur människorna lever och överlever i extremväder. Del 4 av 5.

programme.title: Auktionssommar
programme.desc: Säsongens två mest framgångsrika lag möts i final på en slagauktion på Obbola utanför Umeå. Programledare är Sofia Rågenklint och domare och värderingsmän är Maria Granström och Mats Bergstrand.

programme.title: Morgonstudion
programme.desc: Dagens viktigaste nyheter och analyser med täta uppdateringar. Vi sänder direkt inrikes- och utrikesnyheter inklusive väder, sport, kultur, nöje och lokala nyheter. Dessutom intervjuer med aktuella gäster. Nyhetssammanfattningar varje hel- och halvtimme.

programme.title: Sommargympa med Sofia
programme.desc: Gympa med SVT:s hemmagympapass! Denna gång tar vi hjälp av vattenflaskor.

programme.title: Den stora keramikkampen
programme.desc: Keramikerna möter utmaningen att göra flerfärgade dekorativa vaser, och i det snabba testet ska de dreja den bredaste skålen - utan att se!

programme.title: Mickes båt
programme.desc: Äntligen är det vår, och medlemmarna i båtklubben gläds åt vårtecknet att få ta bort presenningarna från båtarna! Micke har hunnit med en hel del och ger sig nu på slipning och bottenmålning. Han träffar Mats, som ägnade många år åt att renovera Ivan Kreugers träbåt Loris. Micke Leijnegard har fått en gammal träbåt. Nu har han två månader på sig att få den sjöduglig.

programme.title: Världens sämsta indier
programme.desc: David får i uppdrag av Malin att fördjupa sin andliga sida. Han provar på att konvertera till hinduismen och badar i den heliga, men också väldigt smutsiga, floden Ganges. Malin träffar ett gift par som skapat stor uppståndelse i sin hemstad eftersom de gift sig över religionsgränsen. David Batra reser till Indien för att hitta sitt indiska jag. Till sin hjälp har han Malin Mendel, SVT:s korrespondent i Indien. Del 4 av 6.

programme.title: Hjälp, vi har köpt ett franskt ruckel!
programme.desc: Brita ger sig ut på jakt efter svar kring vad man egentligen får - och inte får - göra i byn. Det leder till ett oväntat möte med självaste borgmästaren som snabbt spårar Arbetet med en ny köksstomme kickas igång, men det visar sig snart att de franska snickarna inte är helt mottagliga för Britas idéer.

programme.title: Hur fan hamnade vi här?
programme.desc: Sverige har blivit ett allt mer populärt resmål. Men på vissa platser har besökarna blivit så många att lokalborna börjar säga ifrån. Trängsel, förändrade miljöer och en pressad infrastruktur väcker frågan: hur mycket turism tål egentligen Sverige - och vem ska betala? Messiah Hallberg granskar Sveriges överturism och letar efter en möjlig räddning: landets nästa oupptäckta turistpärla.

programme.title: Alan och Amandas grekiska husdröm
programme.desc: Sommaren på Korfu går mot sitt slut när Alan Carr och Amanda Holden gör klart det sista utrymmet: en social uteplats med pergola, stenbyggd grill och liten pool för kvällsbad. Samtidigt tar Amanda hand om en herrelös katt som ska följa med hem, Alan testar Zorba-dans i åskregn, och vännerna samlas för att fira den färdiga familjevillan innan det är dags att säga adjö.

programme.title: Arvinge okänd - Danmark
programme.desc: Henny dör i Nakskov efter ett liv där hon länge hjälpt människor i nöd i sitt lokalsamhälle. Men vem fanns där för henne? Finns det över huvud taget några arvingar - och varför kallades hon ”flickan med barnvagnen”? Det undrar programledaren Mette Frisk och arkivarien Adam Jon Kronegh.

programme.title: Vilda kockar
programme.desc: Erik Brännström och Leila Lindholm, Lisa Lemke och Erik Videgård samt Zeina Mourtada och Filip Poon tävlar i tre lag om vilka som kan laga den godaste maten över öppen eld. Under ledning av Niklas Ekstedt har lagen en timme på sig att göra en förrätt och en varmrätt.

programme.title: Toy Story 2
programme.desc: Woody bär på en hemlighet som inte ens han själv känner till: Han är en riktigt värdefull samlarleksak som det inte finns många exemplar kvar av i hela världen! Så när en samvetslös leksakshandlare stjäl Woody drar ett nytt och helvilt äventyr igång för Buzz Lightyear, Rex, Hamm och alla de andra leksakerna. Nu gäller det att rädda Woody till varje pris! Spåren leder till en leksaksaffär där Woody hamnat i sällskap med några andra värdefulla leksaker; cowboytjejen Jessie, hästen Bullseye och Guldgrävarn – hans riktiga familj! Men leksakshandlaren har inga planer på att leka med dem.

programme.title: Där ingen skulle tro att någon kunde bo
programme.desc: Ingebjørg är född och uppvuxen på Vorterøy i Lyngenfjorden i Troms fylke i norra Norge. Två gånger har hon drivits därifrån av olika anledningar, och två gånger har hon kommit tillbaka, så fort hon bara kunde. Nu har hon inga planer på att ge sig av igen. Inte förrän det händer som ska hända till slut, säger Ingebjørg. Arve Uglum möter människor som berättar om att bo långt ifrån staden, men nära naturen och om de livsval som har fört dem dit.

programme.title: Levande och döda i Winsford
programme.desc: Maria behöver fly från sitt gamla liv. En kväll anländer hon till byn Winsford på Exmoor i sydvästra England och bosätter sig med sin hund i ett ensligt beläget hus uppe på heden. Varför hon var tvungen att fly är oklart men hennes förflutna reds sakta ut. Vad har hänt med hennes man? Vem var han egentligen och vad var det han var anklagad för? Är det någon som letar efter henne?

programme.title: Vi på Saltkråkan
programme.desc: Sommaren är nästan slut och familjen Melkersson ska åka hem. Tjorven och Pelle drömmer om nästa sommar när chocken kommer: Uffe ska sälja Snickargården! Barnen försöker stoppa det, men ingenting hjälper. Ska de inte få komma tillbaka till Saltkråkan igen? Eller kan Melker bli hjälte genom att bada med kläderna på?

programme.title: Komiker utan gränser
programme.desc: Tävlingsunderhållning med de oblyga komikerna Pernilla Wahlgren, Kristina Keyyo Petrushina, Per Andersson och David Batra som utför olika, mer eller mindre, jobbiga utmaningar på allmänna platser i Stockholm, Köpenhamn och Oslo. Det görs inför dolda kameror och med folk på stan. Programledare: Robin Paulsson.

programme.title: Misstänkt
programme.desc: Efter den chockerande händelsen skakas både polisstationen och skolan, och Michael tvingas konfrontera omfattningen av det som hänt. Ivan vill snabbt stänga utredningen, men Annie vägrar ge sig och pressar fram ett nytt avslöjande. Nya förhör och bevis pekar först mot en gärningsman - men avslöjar sedan en djupt chockerande ny misstänkt, när utredningen når sitt slutskede. I rollerna: David Morrissey, Emma Appleton, Oscar Batterham, Jodie McNee, Eve Myles, Jennifer Macbeth m.fl.

programme.desc: Nyheter från Sverige och världen.

programme.title: Nordsjön
programme.desc: En oljeplattform sjunker plötsligt och oväntat utanför Ormen Langefältet. Forskare försöker desperat hitta lösningen på den till synes oförklarade händelsen. Hela landet håller andan när det visar sig att olyckan bara är början på något som kommer att bli mycket allvarligare. Det blir ett mänskligt drama om liv och död när tusentals oljearbetare plötsligt fastnar på plattformar över Nordsjön. Den största räddningsaktionen i Norges historia är ett faktum.

programme.desc: Några av världens främsta jazzmusiker, som Quincy Jones, Don Cherry och Dexter Gordon, lämnade under 1950-, 60-, och 70-talen USA för Sverige. Flera stannade kvar och bildade familjer. På den musikaliska sidan uppstod ett givande utbyte mellan de amerikanska och svenska musikerna.

programme.title: Spårlöst försvunnen
programme.desc: Emilie, Mikkel och Maria har inte sett sin mamma på mer än två år. En vårdag 2018 lämnar hon hemmet utanför Aarhus utan att säga farväl. Var är deras mamma, och varför försvann hon?

programme.title: Hundskolan
programme.desc: Det är dags för nya betyg innan hundarna och deras ägare ska hem till vardag och fortsatt träning. När Basse plötsligt skäller till behövs akut hjälp, och Kathrine får extra stöd av Maren för att orka vidare. Del 4 av 6.

programme.title: Matadorerna – Dynastin Mærsk
programme.desc: När Hitler ockuperar Danmark skickar A.P. Møller sin son Mærsk till det neutrala USA för att hålla rederiets flotta utanför kriget. Men kan Mærsk lämna sin nyfunna kärlek, ungdomsförälskelsen Emma? Både varvet och vapenfabriken Riffelsyndikatet gör affärer med den tyska ockupationsmakten och A.P. Møller anser att han inte har något val när regeringen uppmanar till samarbete. Tillsammans med en grupp likasinnade företagsledare försöker han avsätta statsminister Thorvald Stauning, som de menar har svikit Danmark.

I centrum står den gamla släktgården som stått öde i flera år - kan den bli en ny trygg punkt när omvärlden hårdnar? En kortfilm ur satsningen Mina drömmars land från 2026,

programme.title: Jakten på jättetonfisken
programme.desc: Bård avsätter tre dagar för tonfiskfiske på Vestlandet tillsammans med Lars. Men hårt väder och krångliga omständigheter gör att tiden håller på att rinna dem händerna.

programme.title: Balansakten
programme.desc: 1960-talets Sverige rustar upp och siktar mot att bli en av världens få kärnvapenmakter. Samtidigt försöker Finland bibehålla sin självständighet under ständigt tryck från Sovjet i öst.

programme.title: Så byggdes Sverige
programme.desc: Tidsresan börjar i gruvorten Kiruna år 1927 där Gert Wingårdh vill undersöka om Kiruna verkligen är staden den utger sig för att vara, nämligen världens bästa stad. Men att åka ner i Kirunagruvan skrämmer slag på honom. Samtidigt åker Petra Mede tåg genom brukslandskapet med fd svetsaren och statsministern Stefan Löfven. Mark Isitt reser till Åtvidaberg för att spela fotboll och samtidigt förstå hur en så liten ort kunde vara bäst på så mycket medan Gert undrar vad som blivit Borlänges räddning hemma hos paret Pernilla Wåhlin Norén och Gustaf Norén. Är bruksorten på väg tillbaka igen, och vad betyder det i så fall för Sverige om 100 år?

programme.title: Dieselsmugglarna
programme.desc: Dieselsmugglingen uppfattas nu som systemhotande. Operation gränsland, samarbetet mellan svenska och finska myndigheter, pågår. Polisens spanare arbetar i hemlighet, men smugglarna börjar ana att någonting är på gång.

programme.title: Spårlöst försvunnen
programme.desc: Emilie, Mikkel och Maria har inte sett sin mamma på mer än två år. En vårdag 2018 lämnar hon hemmet utanför Aarhus utan att säga farväl. Var är deras mamma, och varför försvann hon?

programme.title: Pilsnerraggarna
programme.desc: Matha, Kimmen, Emma och Tilde ska shoppa en husvagn som de ska fixa upp och festa i. De har hittat ett fallfärdigt objekt och nu ska pärlan hämtas hem. Men försäljningsplatsen ger gänget dåliga vibbar.

programme.title: Syskon på semester
programme.desc: Tillbaka på lägre höjd möter de nytt liv - i form av en nyfödd killing. Ett gammalt sommarhus bär på historier om adel och lyxliv medan Topi prövas som nykterist på vinprovning. Dagen avslutas med en meditation som väcker mer känslor än väntat.

programme.title: Familjen Adampour
programme.desc: Mina och Sophia bävar för att avslöjas som okunniga i frågesporten Alla mot alla. Diana är minst lika nervös - hon står inför att berätta sin stora hemlighet för familjen. Del 7 av 10.

programme.title: Vetenskapens värld
programme.desc: Del 2: Manipulationer. Växter har lärt sig att listigt manipulera sin omvärld för att överleva olika faror. Mikroskopiska horn, hot om hämnd, larmsignaler och ett avancerat beslutsfattande är delar av växternas försvarssystem. Det är ett spektakulärt maskineri. Växter kan såväl svettas tanniner som släppa ut brandfarliga gaser. Vi får här också följa växternas liv inifrån växterna själva. Forskare och experter kan nu förklara metoderna som växter använder för att manipulera världen och leva framgångsrikt. Programmet sändes första gången 2025.

programme.title: Montreux jazzfestival
programme.desc: Claudes vision om festivalen breddas och efter att under de första åren ha fokuserat på rena jazzframträdanden börjar nu också artister som David Bowie, Freddie Mercury, Talking Heads, James Brown och Van Morrison ta plats på scenen i Montreux. Det var Deep Purple som sa det först: We all came out to Montreux... Med unika arkivbilder från konserter och backstage berättas historien om den legendariska jazzfestivalen i Montreux.

programme.title: Rapport
programme.desc: Nyheter från Sverige och världen.

programme.title: Damallsvenskan: IFK Norrkoeping - Hammarby IF
programme.desc: Norrköping tar emot Hammarby i damallsvenskans tolfte omgång. Direkt från Norrköpings idrottspark.

programme.title: Friidrotts-SM
programme.desc: Sveriges främsta friidrottare samlas på Uppsala friidrottsarena för utomhus-SM. På dagens schema bland annat damernas finaler i höjdhopp, stavhopp, diskus och 100 m häck, samt herrarnas finaler i diskus, längdhopp och 110 m häck. Kommentatorer: Gustav Zetterlund och Alhaji Jeng.

programme.title: När jazzlegenderna kom till Sverige
programme.desc: Några av världens främsta jazzmusiker, som Quincy Jones, Don Cherry och Dexter Gordon, lämnade under 1950-, 60-, och 70-talen USA för Sverige. Flera stannade kvar och bildade familjer. På den musikaliska sidan uppstod ett givande utbyte mellan de amerikanska och svenska musikerna.

programme.title: Jazz: Silje Nergaard och Vince Mendoza
programme.desc: Sångerskan Silje Nergaard i en stämningsfull konsert med den norska radioorkestern KORK under ledning av flerfaldigt Grammybelönade kompositören och arrangören Vince Mendoza.

programme.title: Callas i Tosca från Covent Garden
programme.desc: Ljudinspelningarna av hundraårsjubilerande Maria Callas går att räkna i hundratal. Filminspelningarna från hennes operaframträdanden är däremot försvinnande få. Den gastkramande andra akten Puccinis Tosca, inspelad på Covent Garden-operan i London 1964 är därför unik i sitt slag. Föreställningen som regisserades av Franco Zeffirelli blev något av en comeback för divan, i ett läge när många trodde att hennes karriär var över. Tillsammans med Callas på scenen ser vi Tito Gobbi som den diaboliske baron Scarpia och Renato Cioni i rollen som Toscas älskade Cavaradossi. Covent Garden-operans orkester dirigeras av Carlo Felice Cillario.

programme.title: Joyland
programme.desc: Familjen Rana är lycklig men går i väntans tider. Med bägge fötter stadigt i traditionerna längtar man efter att sönerna ska bli framgångsrika och att deras fruar ska föda söner som säkrar släktens framtid. Men det är inte alla i familjen som vill samma sak. Yngste sonen Haider skaffar i hemlighet jobb på en burlesk dansteater. Där blir Haider upp över öronen förälskad i Bibi, en transkvinna som är showens fixstjärna. Deras omöjliga kärlekshistoria kastar sakta men säkert nytt ljus över hela familjen Ranas inre konflikter mellan traditioner och ett sexuellt uppror.

programme.title: Matadorerna – Dynastin Mærsk
programme.desc: När Hitler ockuperar Danmark skickar A.P. Møller sin son Mærsk till det neutrala USA för att hålla rederiets flotta utanför kriget. Men kan Mærsk lämna sin nyfunna kärlek, ungdomsförälskelsen Emma? Både varvet och vapenfabriken Riffelsyndikatet gör affärer med den tyska ockupationsmakten och A.P. Møller anser att han inte har något val när regeringen uppmanar till samarbete. Tillsammans med en grupp likasinnade företagsledare försöker han avsätta statsminister Thorvald Stauning, som de menar har svikit Danmark.

programme.title: Finlandsfärjornas försvunna passagerare
programme.desc: Ett nytt tips leder utredningen i en dramatisk riktning. Uppgifter från den kriminella världen väcker frågor om våld, tystnadskultur och vad som egentligen kan ske ombord när ingen ser.

programme.title: LA CABANE À HISTOIRES
programme.desc: Dans la cabane, Noé et Paloma attendent Jade avec impatience pour attaquer le goûter. Quand Jade arrive avec des fruits bien mures, Noé le gourmand voudrait tous les manger. Paloma, elle, elle n'en veut pas. Ses amis n'en reviennent pas : comment est-ce possible de ne pas aimer les fruits ? Après la lecture d'une belle histoire, Noé et Jade comprennent qu'il ne faut pas la forcer à manger ce qu'elle n'aime pas. Paloma se sert plutôt une bonne part de camembert, rapporté par Noé. Chacun ses goûts !

programme.title: CHÂTEAU !

Elle a 20 ans, lui est à peine plus âgé, ils s'éprennent l'un de l'autre et déclarent rapidement leur intention de se marier. Mais les parents de Jean ne voient pas cette union d'un bon oeil. À partir de son vécu et de ses enquêtes, elle déconstruit la négrophobie et les impensés raciaux au sein des diasporas nord-africaines, notamment dans son podcast « Y'a ça chez nous ? ».

Quand Uska mord Tommy et Audrey, Tommy pense que c'est mieux d'en parler à Hector... qui décide d'envoyer Uska dans un refuge spécialisé ! programme.desc: När Red grips och förs till en hemling häktesanläggning ger sig Liz och arbetsgruppen ut för att rädda honom. Red möter en tjuv vid namn Luther Braxton.

programme.title: The Mentalist

programme.title: The Mentalist
programme.desc: Jane och teamet utreder mordet på en äldre arvtagerska, vars lik påträffas i vardagsrummet på hennes spöklika hus.

programme.title: Spin City
programme.desc: Borgmästaren är trött på de ständiga grälen mellan Mike och Caitlin och beordrar dem därför att gå till parterapi.

programme.desc: En av borgmästarens rika givare bestämmer sig för att själv kandidera.

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: McCall är en tidigare fältjägare som efter att ha fejkat sin egen död lever ett stilla liv. Han får ett ofrivilligt avbrott i pensionen då han måste rädda en ung flicka, Teri, och plötsligt står öga mot öga mot ett gäng våldsamma ryska gangsters.

programme.title: Svenska Truckers

programme.title: Simpsons

programme.title: Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer blir överväldigad av sina känslor av ilska och förbittring när farfar blir en omtänksam styvfar till sin flickväns egendomliga son. Lisa och Bart ordnar det ultimata pyjamaspartyt.

programme.title: Simpsons
programme.desc: En framtidssaga om det mest osannolika paret i Springfield. Kan de kanske aldrig bli tillsammans trots allt?

programme.title: Kung av Queens

programme.title: SEAL Team
programme.desc: Jason Hayes leder teamet på ett uppdrag i Serbien för att spåra en organisation med kopplingar till flera bombattentat som utförts mot amerikanska militärbaser.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.title: Paimenen ääni

Jos seurakunta löytää alkuperäisen identiteettinsä, se vaikuttaa koko kansakunnan ohjautumiseen uudistuksen ja parantumisen tielle.

programme.title: Yliluonnollista
programme.desc: Vieraana Chad Gonzales. Pääsiäisenä tapahtui ihmeellinen tapahtuma – historian suurin joukkoparantumiskokous! Chad paljastaa, mitä Jumala näytti hänelle tästä ainutlaatuisesta hetkestä ja miten se on avain yliluonnolliseen paranemiseen tänä päivänä. Voisiko tämä ilmestys avata sinun läpimurtosi?

programme.title: Isännän pöydässä

programme.title: Kesäjuhlien helmiä
programme.desc: Antisemitismin muuttuvat kasvot. Susanna Kokkosen puhe avaa syvällisesti antisemitismin juuria ja Israelin merkitystä raamatullisesta ja historiallisesta näkökulmasta. Kansainvälisesti tunnettu holokausti- ja antisemitismitutkija Kokkonen käsittelee Israelin oikeutta olemassaoloon sekä kristittyjen roolia antisemitismiin vastaamisessa. Puhe tarjoaa ajankohtaisen ja rohkean katsauksen globaalin vihamielisyyden kasvuun. Vapaakirkon kesäjuhlilla kesäkuussa 2024.

Stevenson saa tietää joutuneensa osaksi hallituksen masinoimaa koetta, jossa testataan uutta teknologiaa nimeltä ?Source Code?. Se on ohjelma, jonka avulla hänet voidaan siirtää toisen henkilön ruumiiseen tasan kahdeksan minuutin ajaksi ennen tämän kuolemaa.

programme.desc: Clyde Sheltonin (Gerald Butler) elämä romahtaa kahden murtovar- kaan tappaessa hänen perheenjäsenensä. Syyttäjä Nick Rice (Jamie Foxx) ei pidä todistusaineistoa tarpeeksi pitävänä ja tekee sopimuksen, joka passittaa toisen varkaista kuolemanselliin toisen kärsiessä minimaalisen rangaistuksen. Shelton ei voi niellä tapahtunutta ja palaa kymmenen vuotta myöhemmin ottamaan oikeuden omiin käsiinsä: toteutettava suunnitelma on nerokas, mutta samalla mielipuolinen. Tämä kosto on ennennäkemätöntä suuruusluokkaa, eikä kohteena ole pelkästään vapaalla jalalla elämänsä viettävä murhaaja, vaan myös kaikki muut oikeusmurhan osalliset. Lainkuuliainen kansalainen on raaka ja jännittävä trilleri, jonka pääosissa nähdään Gerard Butler (300, Gamer) ja Oscar-voittaja Jamie Foxx (Miami Vice, Collateral).

Humaltuessaan Cully taantuu kuitenkin taas omaksi rehenteleväksi itsekseen. Vanhat viholliset Marty ja A.J. puolestaan jatkavat siitä mihin koulussa jäivät ja yrittävät tehdä vaikutuksen luokan ihanimpaan tyttöön.

programme.title: Croodit (0)
programme.desc: Lähde mukaan Croodien huikealle matkalle tässä eeppisessä komediaseikkailussa Madagascar- ja Näin koulutat lohikäärmeesi –elokuvien tekijöiltä. Ikimuistoisten henkilöiden, värikkäiden otusten ja vehreiden maisemien lisäksi Croodit tarjoaa takuuvarmasti naurua ja hupia kaikenikäisille!

programme.title: Ryhmä Hau: Elokuva (0)
programme.desc: Ryhmä Hau on vauhdissa… ensimmäisessä seikkailussaan laajakankaalla! Uuden Lilli-pennun avulla Ryhmä Hau taistelee pelastaakseen Jännälän kaupungin väen kilpailijaltaan Hanttiselta. Voiko Ryhmä Hau pelastaa kaupungin, ennen kuin on liian myöhäistä?

programme.title: Kätyrit: Grun tarina (7)
programme.desc: Kätyrit: Grun tarina. Gru kasvaa lähiössä 1970-luvun puolivälissä, sulkia tukassaan ja leveälahkeiset farkut jalassaan. Gru fanittaa superpahisten ryhmää, joita kutsutaan nimellä Kätyrit. Hän laatii suunnitelman, joka varmistaa häenelle jäsenyyden ryhmässä olemalla tarpeeksi paha.

programme.title: Trolls: Maailmankiertue (0)
programme.desc: Maailmankiertueella Poppy ja Branch huomaavat, että heidän kuningaskuntansa on vain yksi kuudesta eri musiikkityylille omistautuneesta maailmasta, jotka elivät aiemmin täydellisessä harmoniassa.

programme.title: Bamse ja rosvokaupunki (0)
programme.desc: Bamse ja Rosvokaupunki -elokuvassa saamme seurata Bamsen, Kilpisen ja Pompin uutta jännittävää seikkailua läpi Peikkometsän. Paha Kasimir Kettu on koonnut kaikki kylän rosvot yhteen kaapatakseen isoäidin, jotta Bamse ei koskaan enää saisi jymyhunajaa. Bamse ei emmi, vaan lähtee yhdessä uskollisten ystäviensä kanssa synkkään Peikkometsään ja Rosvokaupunkiin pelastamaan isoäitiä.

programme.title: Late Lammas - Elokuva (0)
programme.desc: Shaunin vapaapäivästä tuleekin toiminnantäyteinen. Sekaannus ja jyrkkä mäki johtavat suurkaupunkiin, jossa Shaunin tehtävä on ohjata lauma kotiin.

programme.title: Sing (0)
programme.desc: Buster Moon johtaa parhaat päivänsä nähnyttä teatteria. Buster on ikuinen optimisti, joka rakastaa teatteriaan yli kaiken ja on valmis tekemään mitä vain pelastaakseen sen.

programme.title: Paavo Pesusieni -elokuva (0)
programme.desc: Vedenalaisessa maailmassa eletään epävakaita aikoja. Joku on varastanut kuningas Neptunuksen kruunun, ja epäilykset kohdistuvat Paavo Pesusienen pomoon. Puhdistaakseen pomonsa maineen Pesusieni ystävineen lähtee vaaralliselle matkalle.

programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level (12)
programme.desc: Palatessaan Jumanjiin pelastamaan yhtä omistaan he huomaavat, että peli on yllätyksiä täynnä. Paetakseen pelaajien on uhmattava tutkimattomia seutuja, aina kuivista aavikoista lumisiin vuoriin.

programme.title: Rakkaus lainassa (12)
programme.desc: Rachel on uskollinen ystävä kihlautuneelle Darcylle. Täytettyään 30 vuotta, Rachel päätyy kuitenkin luonteensa vastaisesti pitkäaikaisen ihastuksensa, Dexin, kainaloon.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle (12)
programme.desc: Neljän nuoren löytämä vanha konsoli sisältää ikivanhan pelin – Jumanji. Heidän täytyy selvittää, mitä Alan Parrish jätti taakseen 20 vuotta sitten – muuten he jäävät jumiin pelin sisälle.

programme.title: 10 Years (12)
programme.desc: Jake rakastaa tyttöystäväänsä ja on aikeissa kosia, mutta sitten hän törmää kouluaikaiseen ihastukseensa. Hänen ystävänsä Cully on mennyt naimisiin cheerleader-tyttöystävänsä kanssa ja aikoo nyt luokkakokouksessa pyytää anteeksi kaikilta niiltä, joita koulussa kiusasi. Humaltuessaan Cully taantuu kuitenkin taas omaksi rehenteleväksi itsekseen. Vanhat viholliset Marty ja A.J. puolestaan jatkavat siitä mihin koulussa jäivät ja yrittävät tehdä vaikutuksen luokan ihanimpaan tyttöön.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Kohti Hämähäkkiversumia (7)
programme.desc: Milesilla on tavallisen teinin huolet koulujen ja kaverien kanssa, mutta sen lisäksi hän on uusi Spider-Man. Kun hän tapaa Peter Parkerin multiversessa, pitää hänen ryhtyä kaupunkinsa suojelijaksi.

programme.title: I Care a Lot (15)
programme.desc: Voimakkaalla itsevarmuudella varustettu Marla Grayson (Rosamund Pike) on oikeuden osoittama ammattilainen, joka toimii edunvalvojana kymmenille vanhuksille, joiden varat hän ottaa itselleen kieroilla, mutta laillisilla keinoilla. Marla ja hänen liikekumppaninsa/rakastajansa Fran (Eiza González) käyttävät tätä huippuunsa hiottua huijausta äärettömän tehokkaasti uusimman uhrinsa, Jennifer Petersonin (Dianne Wiest), kohdalla. Jennifer on varakas eläkeläinen, jolla ei ole elossa olevia sukulaisia. Kun käy ilmi, että heidän uhrillaan on aivan yhtä kiero salaisuus ja yhteyksiä räjähdysherkkään gangsteriin (Peter Dinklage), Marlan on noustava uudelle tasolle tässä pelissä, jota vain saalistajat voivat pelata, pelissä, jossa ei ole sääntöjä.

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You (12)
programme.desc: Muistatko sen ihanan miehen, joka sanoi soittavansa eikä soittanutkaan? Ehkä hän kadotti numerosi. Ehkä hän on sairaalassa. Tai ehkä sinun tulisi vain muistaa: älä tuhlaa aikaasi vääriin miehiin.

programme.title: She Came to Me (12)
programme.desc: Paluuta tekevä säveltäjä Steven Lauddem kärsii luovuuden puutteesta eikä saa tärkeää oopperaansa valmiiksi. Vaimonsa ja entisen terapeuttinsa Patrician kehotuksesta hän lähtee etsimään inspiraatiota.

programme.title: American Hustle (15)
programme.desc: Irving Rosenfeld on huijari, jonka rikoskumppani on viettelevä brittikaunotar, Sydney Prosser. Räväkkä FBI-agentti, Richie DiMaso, saa kaksikon nalkkiin ja pakottaa nämä yhteistyöhön kanssaan.

programme.title: Valo valtameren yllä (12)
programme.desc: Ensimmäisestä maailmansodasta kotiutunut majakanvartija Tom ja hänen nuori vaimonsa Isabel asuvat kaksin täysin eristyksissä olevalla saarella Australian rannikolla. Vastavihityn parin onnea varjostaa ainoastaan kipeä epäonni lapsen saannissa. Rajun myrskyn jälkeen ja jälleen yhden pitkälle edenneen raskauden keskeydyttyä rantaan ajautuu pirstaleinen vene, miehen ruumis, naisen villatakki – ja pieni tyttövauva, joka on elossa.

programme.title: Wonder (7)
programme.desc: Menestysromaaniin perustuva WONDER kertoo August Pullmanin innoittavan ja sydäntä lämmittävän tarinan. Kasvojen epämuodostuman takia Auggie ei ole aiemmin käynyt normaalia koulua, mutta nyt hän aloittaa viidennen luokan muiden lasten kanssa. Hänen perheensä, uudet luokkatoverit ja koko yhteisö joutuvat koville yrittäessään sopeutua erilaiseen tilanteeseen. Auggien uskomaton matka yhdistää lopulta heidät kaikki ja todistaa, ettei voi sulautua joukkoon, kun on syntynyt erottautumaan.

programme.title: After (12)
programme.desc: Tessa Young on 18-vuotias college-opiskelija, jolla on kiltti poikaystävä. Hänen elämänsä kulkee suunnitelmien mukaisesti, kunnes hän tapaa röyhkeän ja töykeän Hardinin, joka sekoittaa pakan.

programme.title: Life of the Party (12)
programme.desc: Kun Deannan mies yllättäen jättää hänet, päättää keski-ikäinen Deanna palata takaisin opiskelemaan saadakseen tutkintonsa valmiiksi. 100 min. Ohjaus: Ben Falcone. Pääosissa: Melissa McCarthy, Matthew Jason Walsh ja Molly Gordon.

programme.title: The Fall Guy (12)
programme.desc: Sijaisnäyttelijänä toiminut David Leitch, hittielokuvien Bullet Train ja Deadpool 2 ohjaaja ja hittielokuvien John Wick ja Nobody tuottaja, ohjasi tähän asti henkilökohtaisimman elokuvansa.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming (12)
programme.desc: Nuori Peter Parker/Spider-Man alkaa totutella uuteen identiteettiinsä seittiä sinkoavana supersankarina. Peter palaa kotiinsa, jossa hän asuu May-tätinsä kanssa, ja elää uuden mentorinsa Tony Starkin valvovan katseen alla. Peter yrittää palata normaaliin arkirutiiniinsa, mutta kun uusi roisto Vulture ilmaantuu, kaikki Peterin sydäntä lähellä olevat asiat ovat uhattuina.

programme.title: Roofman - kattokeikkailija (15)
programme.desc: Perustuu uskomattomaan tositarinaan Jeffrey Manchesterista. Vankilasta paennut Jeff piileskelee kuusi kuukautta Toys ”R” Us -lelukaupassa kenenkään huomaamatta ja suunnittelee seuraavaa siirtoaan. Mutta kun hän rakastuu eronneeseen äitiin, Leighin, hänen kaksoiselämänsä alkaa paljastua, mikä käynnistää kiehtovan, uskomattoman ja jännittävän kissa ja hiiri -leikin, kun hänen menneisyytensä alkaa saada häntä kiinni.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz (15)
programme.desc: Nicholas Angel on paras poliisi mitä Lontoon poliisivoimissa on nähty. Hänen suorittamiensa pidätysten lukumäärä on 400% parempi kuin seuraavaksi parhaalla.

programme.title: Englantilainen romantikko (15)
programme.desc: (Some Kind of Beautiful, USA 2015) Richard joutuu luopumaan sinkkuelämästään, kun häntä paljon nuorempi Kate ilmoittaa odottavansa hänelle lasta. Kolme vuotta myöhemmin Kate rakastuu toiseen mieheen.

programme.title: Yhdet vielä (12)
programme.desc: Neljä ystävystä päättää testata teoriaa siitä, että ihmisellä on syntyessään kehossaan puolen promillen alkoholivaje. Teorian mukaan alkoholi veressä avaa aistit ulkomaailmalle ja tekee luovemmaksi.
